actual_fit_plans.baseline_selection: first realization of first two source IDs in sorted validation source IDs, independent of measurement and truth values
actual_fit_plans.baseline_posterior_check: split R-hat <1.05 and bulk approximate ESS >100 for every target; otherwise explicitly unconverged, no winner claim
actual_fit_plans.neural_architecture: train-only PCA(32), tanh MLP 32->32->14, four means plus lower triangular precision factor with positive softplus diagonal; full-covariance logit-normal posterior
actual_fit_plans.parameter_support: exact configured bounds; uniform prior in log10 EM0/log10 major EM FWHM and linear Te/q; neural output uses logit of prior-unit coordinate divided by pi/sqrt(3)
actual_fit_plans.loss: conditional Gaussian negative log density in scaled logit prior coordinates; constant per-label Jacobian cancels model selection; Adam with global norm clipping
actual_fit_plans.selection: single full-data architecture; best validation NLL with patience/min_delta; test sealed until checkpoint and settings freeze; no calibration tuned on test
actual_fit_plans.half_data_diagnostic: repeat same architecture on first floor(397/2) sorted training parents, PCA fit only those rows; solely learning-curve diagnostic, not a model selection sweep
actual_fit_plans.baseline: bounded conventional posterior over four targets, PA, east/north offsets and two Gaussian standardized calibration nuisances; identical full Fourier measurements and conditional correlated thermal Gaussian likelihood; exact existing forward renderer; two MAP starts, local Jacobian proposal and four independent Metropolis chains
actual_fit_plans.baseline_prior: same configured target priors; PA uniform [0,180), offsets uniform [-10,10] arcsec, common loggain=-s^2/2+s*z with z~N(0,1), spectral slope=.01*z with z~N(0,1); no private nuisance truths
actual_fit_plans.forward_checks: test first realization per source: at neural posterior marginal median, fit PA/offset/gains to measurements with target fixed (profile residual, not posterior predictive); on baseline subset sample full joint posterior forward renders for posterior predictive residuals; any neural nuisance augmentation is labelled conditional/profile approximation
actual_fit_plans.metrics: original-unit MAE/RMSE, median and p90 absolute relative error; log10 error for EM/size; central 50/80/95% marginal coverage, PIT, interval widths, joint Mahalanobis coverage in transformed coordinates; source-group bootstrap uncertainty; prior midpoint diagnostic; all observations and parent-averaged losses distinguished
actual_fit_plans.limits: 397 independent training parents, 67 validation, 48 test. Gaussian conditional approximation can miss multimodality/curved degeneracy and insufficient summaries can discard information. Test previously audited scientifically, not external blind data. No real-data training/download, no bulk generation, no cloud/paid compute, no artifact upload.
actual_fit_plans.decision: pipeline success requires finite trained/checkpointed model and frozen-test evaluation; scientific acceptance additionally requires credible heldout errors/calibration and converged comparator. Report needs more data/model work otherwise.

protocol.source_selection: First198 sorted original training source IDs;396 observations; no data-dependent subset selection
protocol.normalization: Own396-row feature mean/std (ddof0); own PCA32; target log10 EM/size and linear Te/q statistics from198 unique half-training parents, stored separately. The model uses the same fixed prior-logit target coordinates as canonical full run.
protocol.rule: Set optimizer cap from remaining whole-job allowance with5s PCA/finalization reserve. Abort before fitting if insufficient time; report any binding cap as budget-limited, not equivalent convergence. No automatic restart. Expected fit is well below this budget from existing measured runs.
protocol.interpretation: Correct one implementation fairness defect. One half/full pair at one seed on reused validation is not data-sufficiency evidence. Preserve historical confounded half run.
